author: ghyls
body:
#### PR description:

Make the `edmMpiSplitConfig` take the module dependencies from the framework, through the `DumpDependencyGraph` service, instead of deducing them from the `InputTag` in the unsplit configuration. This allows to:

- Group the offloaded modules by when they run:
  - Before this PR, the offloaded modules are grouped by their dependencies. A module placed behind an `EDFilter` could be grouped with other modules that run on every event if they have the same dependencies, and then run on every event as well.
  - Modules reached under different conditions now go to different groups. An offloaded module runs on exactly the same events as in it did in the original configuration.
- Send only the data products needed by the other side:
  - Before this PR, when a data product of a module was needed by the other process, all the data products of that module were sent.
  - Now only the data products consumed by the other process are sent.


Support for the portable MPI modules will be added in a future PR, right after this one.

#### PR validation:

Two unit tests are added in `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/test`:
- `testOffloadedModulesDoNotRunMoreThanNeeded` checks that offloaded modules behind a filter run the same number of times as in the single-process configuration.
- `testSplitterSendsOnlyConsumedProducts` checks the contents of every `MPISender`, and verifies that only the products that are expected to be sent are actually sent.

The two tests, and the existing ones, pass.
title: Make the edmMpiSplitConfig retrieve the module dependency graph from DumpDependencyGraph
